indicator.name: Modern contraceptive use rate
indicator.description: Percentage of currently married women age 15–49 currently using any modern contraceptive method in the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey.
indicator.expected_source: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey 2022, Key Indicators Report Table 8C
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published for all 47 counties. The source-reported weighted number of currently married women age 15–49 is retained as survey precision metadata.

observations.source_table: Key Indicators Report Table 8C — Current use of contraception according to county
observations.notes: Direct KDHS 2022 Table 8C Any modern method point estimate for currently married women age 15–49. Source-reported weighted denominator retained; no confidence interval or standard error is fabricated and ranking is withheld.
